credentials: Own private .env in each runtime home; native direct-* profile aliases reuse the existing shared-root OAuth store. OAuth tokens are not copied or committed.
skills_policy: Retain all installed source skills, scripts and references; do not prune the broad legacy set in this pilot.
external_dependencies: Preserve MCP commands and installed tool symlinks with explicit absolute paths; parent verifies reachability.
memory_policy: Preserve source backend and limits; SQLite online backup for history, no memory migration.
